Faq.q1: Are the contracts legally valid in Norway?
Faq.a1: Yes. All templates are drafted according to Norwegian law — including the Contracts Act, the Tenancy Act and the Working Environment Act where relevant. Once both parties have signed, the contract is binding just like one drafted by a lawyer.
Faq.q2: Do I need a lawyer to use the contracts?
Faq.a2: No, not for standard situations. The templates cover the most common needs for freelance work, tenancies, NDAs, employment agreements and similar. For particularly complex matters (e.g. large shareholder agreements) we always recommend a legal review.
Faq.a3: You download the contract as a PDF and can either print and sign physically, or use an e-signature solution such as BankID, Signicat or DocuSign. Both forms are legally binding in Norway.
Faq.q4: Can I customize the contract's content?
Faq.a4: Yes. You fill in your own details in a simple form, and the contract is built automatically with the correct wording — you see it take shape in the preview as you type. After download, the PDF is yours to edit further if you like.
Faq.a5: You pay only per contract — from £5. No subscription, no hidden fees, and no lock-in.
Faq.q6: Which payment methods can I use?
Faq.a6: You can pay by card (Visa, Mastercard) via Stripe. Vipps is coming as a payment method later.
Faq.q7: Do I get a refund if I'm not satisfied?
Faq.a7: Since the product is delivered as a digital file with immediate download, the purchase falls outside the right of withdrawal under Norwegian consumer law § 22. We recommend using the preview before paying. Contact us if something is wrong — we'll sort it.
Faq.a8: We only store what's needed to deliver the contract and issue the invoice. Form data is kept safely in your browser during filling, and no contract information is shared with third parties beyond the payment provider.

Legal.privacy1Body: Kontraktly AS is the data controller for personal data collected through the service. We comply with the Norwegian Personal Data Act and GDPR.
Legal.privacy2Body: We only collect what's necessary to generate your contract: name, address, organization number and other fields you fill in yourself. Payment information is handled by Stripe and is never stored with us.
Legal.privacy3Body: Contract data is generated on-demand and is not stored on our servers after the PDF is delivered. Email receipts from Stripe are retained in accordance with Norwegian accounting law (5 years).
Legal.privacy4Body: You have the right to access, correction and deletion of your personal data. Send requests to
Legal.privacy5Body: We only use strictly necessary cookies for the service to function. No tracking or analytics without your consent.
Legal.terms1Body: Kontraktly provides templates for legal documents under Norwegian law. The templates are a starting point and do not replace individual legal advice.
Legal.terms2Body: The price per contract is shown before purchase. Payment is processed via Stripe. VAT is added for customers with a Norwegian billing address.
Legal.terms3Body: After payment is completed, the PDF is generated immediately and can be downloaded directly in the browser. Delivery is considered completed upon download.
Legal.terms4Body: As the service is digital content delivered immediately, the right of withdrawal is waived upon completed purchase per Norwegian Consumer Rights Act §22 letter n.
Legal.terms5Body: Kontraktly is not liable for financial loss resulting from templates being used without qualified review. Use is at your own risk.
Legal.terms6Body: The agreement is governed by Norwegian law. Any disputes shall be resolved amicably, and otherwise at Oslo District Court.
